role: Public Coronatio face surface for the direct xenia-kit lineage band. Direct provider edges are face -> kit -> xenos, outside the beam; a xenos names only its direct xenia-kit lineage band. The kit is maud Rust emitting the exact crown UX/UI markup, with no CSS or JavaScript. The showcase is the executable specification. A disappeared primitive or author-face variable is a major change; an addition is minor; unchanged is patch.

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent optional fields select null primitive behavior

source_sha.description: Crown source commit, exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

primitives.description: Sorted primitive names sourced from the crown UX index; the schema embeds no primitive list.

author_face.description: Sorted author-face variable names sourced from author-face.json; the schema embeds no copy of that file.

path.description: Specimen path relative to the crown root.

sha256.description: Specimen SHA-256, exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

origin.description: Optional; absent selects the server-rendered primitive behavior.

constructor.description: Optional crown repo-relative constructor path, relative to the crown root; present only when origin is browser-constructed, and absent otherwise.

showcase.description: Map keyed by primitive, pointing to the executable showcase specification in crown source rather than embedding source contents.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
